name: xean-resident-ios
description: Capacitor iOS shell for the Xean Resident (tenant) app. This is a separate, standalone Capacitor project from ../.. (the Xean manager/staff app) on purpose — a native app's bundle ID, display name, and WebView start URL are all fixed per Capacitor project, and this app needs its own of all three (ca.xean.tenant / Xean Resident / xean.ca/portal/home). It has no build step and no dependency on the parent frontend package: server.url mode means the WebView navigates straight to the live site, so the local webDir (./www) is only ever a placeholder Capacitor needs at sync time, never actually shown.
